provenance.inputs: Retained campaign receipts, native Codex JSON streams, FLASH plotfiles and native diagnostic CSV on original worker
provenance.radiation_integration: Piecewise constant per native step, overlap-clipped to declared endpoints; all 30 groups required
provenance.magnetic_normalization: Commissioned FLASH build stores B/sqrt(4*pi); magnetic energy density is B_stored squared / 2 in CGS
provenance.radiation_state_normalization: Specific group energies; density multiplied before leaf-cell volume integration
provenance.counter_semantics: Latest native cumulative counters per session; do not sum consecutive resumed-worker cumulative counters
provenance.billing: Native terminal counters are not vendor invoices. Nineteen director streams have no turn.completed usage.

radiation_window_comparison.authority: operator audit of retained CSV, not accepted scientific evidence
radiation_window_comparison.assumption: Piecewise constant power within each recorded solver step. Thirty groups checked for each step.

seeded_window.rule: maximum summed 30-group outgoing power with timestamp in [15,30] ns; connected >= half-maximum interval, clipped to search limits
